name: prose-gate
description: Runnable implementation of an AI-tics and prose-gate checklist for any markdown/plain-text manuscript. Reports 'ban' findings (coined not-X words, contrast formulas, negation catalogues, padded kind/sort/particular wrappers — fix all) and 'review' findings (the-way similes, as-if/for-a-moment crutches, gerund-as-noun, stock body-reaction kit, telling adverbs, copula dodges, AI vocabulary, trailing-participle analysis, false suspense, cliches, coordination chains, fragment stacks, rule-of-three triads), plus density stats (em-dash/thing/intensifier/filter-word counts per 1000 words) and cadence stats (sentence-length burstiness, monotone runs, low-punctuation long sentences). Findings on System-readout lines (bold-only or ALL-CAPS) carry formatException:true per the gate's format exception. Scan only — never edits.
